title: Spec018 runtime readiness and evidence closeout

phases.objective: Produce a deterministic, credential-free, read-only evidence report that binds the source SHA to three database-role readbacks and staging readiness without applying migrations, mutating databases, promoting Production, or activating runtime transitions.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The closeout report is ready for review only when exact-head, role identity, schema/privilege readback, staging readback, CI, and rollback-readiness evidence converge; Production remains separately blocked.
steps: Build an empty report and verify missing or mismatched evidence fails closed.
Build a synthetic all-green staging report with three distinct database roles and exact source SHA binding.
Reject incomplete privilege, schema, staging, CI, rollback, and SHA evidence.
Reject credential-bearing keys and any report that claims migration apply, database mutation, provider calls, or Production promotion.
Validate the report through the standard HTTP API test manifest.
assertions: The report binds expected_sha and observed_sha before readiness can be reviewable.
Runtime, Governance, and Runtime Persistence identities are all required and cannot fall back to one another.
Staging evidence may become ready_for_review, while Production remains blocked and separately authorized.
Migration apply, database mutation, provider calls, deployment, promotion, runtime transition activation, and secrets remain false.
The closeout is a contract/evidence producer and never performs a database or provider operation.
